    05 / A LITTLE CLARITY

    Before we
    take off.

    A few answers to help you start with confidence.

    Do I need a complete technical brief?+

    No. Start with your business, your users, and the problem you want to solve. The project builder above helps you collect the essentials.

    How are the price and timeline decided?+

    They depend on the agreed scope: pages, features, content, and integrations. Share a target date and any budget constraints so the team can assess a practical plan.

    Can my project support Arabic and English?+

    Yes, bilingual interfaces can be included in the scope. We’ll discuss the content, right-to-left layouts, and which parts need translation.

    What should we agree before work begins?+

    Define deliverables, review rounds, payment milestones, ownership and handover, hosting, and any ongoing support in the project agreement.

    Does this website send my project to the team?+

    You can email Zimqora.contact@gmail.com or call 01143627265. Prepare an email to open a draft, review it, then send it yourself. Downloading a copy does not send it.
